	.type	mult_vec, %function
/*
  Function: mult_vec 
  Input:
    x0 = pointer (to an input data block)
    x1 = pointer (to accessing a coefficient array)
  Operation:
    Allocates 144 bytes via malloc and then processes data in an SVE loop.
    (It loads data, shifts and masks with immediate constants, does an mla (using an implicit lane [0])
    and mod reduction via umulh and mls.)
*/
mult_vec:
		stp		x29, x30, [sp, #-80]!
		mov		x29, sp

		mov		x19, x0
		mov		x20, x1

		// Allocate 144 bytes.
		mov		w0, #144
		mov		w21, #51712
		movk	w21, #15258, lsl #16
		bl		malloc
		mov		x24, x0

		ptrue	p0.d
		rdvl	x10, #8
		lsr		x11, x10, #3

		// Load coefficient constant.
		adr		x0, coeff_const
		ld1d	{ z3.d }, p0/z, [x0]

		mov		x8, #0
mult_vec_loop:
		cmp		x8, #144
		b.ge		mult_vec_exit

		// Load one vector from [x20, x8, lsl #3].
		ld1d	{ z4.d }, p0/z, [x20, x8, lsl #3]

		// Shift left then right (using immediate #2).
		lsl		z4.d, p0/m, z4.d, #2
		lsr		z4.d, p0/m, z4.d, #2

		// Mask each element to 16–bits.
		and		z4.d, z4.d, #0xFFFF

		adr		x0, zero_const
		ld1d	{ z5.d }, p0/z, [x0]

		// Multiply–add: accumulate (z4 * constant) into z5.
		mla		z5.d, p0/m, z4.d, z3.d[0]

		// For mod–reduction, load the mod constant and its reciprocal.
		adr		x0, mod_const
		ld1d	{ z1.d }, p0/z, [x0]
		adr		x0, recip_const
		ld1d	{ z2.d }, p0/z, [x0]

		// Copy z5 into a temporary, then do mod reduction.
		mov		z7.d, z5.d
		umulh	z7.d, p0/m, z7.d, z2.d
		mls		z5.d, p0/m, z7.d, z1.d

		st1d	{ z5.d }, p0, [x24, x8, lsl #3]

		add		x8, x8, x11
		b		mult_vec_loop

mult_vec_exit:
		mov		x0, x24
		ldp		x29, x30, [sp], #80

	.type	main, %function
/*
  Function: main
  Operation:
    Allocates a 2592–byte block with calloc, then (for demo)
    stores the “one” constant at two chosen offsets,
    calls mult_mod and mult_vec, and finally prints a 64–bit result.
*/
main:
		stp		x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
		mov		x29, sp

		mov		w1, #2592
		bl		calloc

B1-3, Figure A 1 5 and Configurable SVE vector lengths 
• A SIMD FP register as described in V0-V31 Bits 127 0 of each Zn register hold the 
correspondingly numbered V 0 V 31 SIMD&FPregister,as FigureB1-3 shows: 

Figure B 1 3 SVE scalable vector register naming

• Maximum implemented SVE vector lengths 
• Configurable SVE vector lengths 
• Treatment of SVE scalable vector registers . 
• SVE writes of scalar values to registers . 

P0-P15 16 SVE predicate registers named P 0 toP 15 Each SVE predicate register holds one bit for each byte 
of an SVE scalar vector register 
Note 
The Maximum implemented SVE predicate length is the Maximum implemented SVE vector length 
divided by 8 See Maximum implemented SVE vector lengths

Set scalar to multiple of predicate constraint element count 
Determines the number of active elements implied by the named predicate constraint multiplies that by an immediate in

• The largest multiple of three or four MUL 3 or MUL 4 
• All available implicitly a multiple of two ALL 

Unspecified or out of range constraint encodings generate an empty predicate or zero element count rather than

        .global get_digits
        .type get_digits, %function
get_digits:
        // Clear the destination “digit‐array” using an SVE floating–point move.
        // This fmov (predicated) sets every active element in z0 of type .d to 0.0 (i.e. all zeros).
        fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
        // Using an SVE store we clear the digits (assume the array is at least one vector–length wide).
        st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [x1]
        st1w    {z0.s}[0], p0, [x1, #32]
        cbz     w0, get_digits_ret   // if input is zero, return

; get_digits_loop:
;   Compute: quotient = (w0 * 0x66676667) >> 34  plus correction factor (w0 * constant >> 63)
;   Then remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
;   Finally, index = remainder * 4 (sbfiz) into the digit array, which is incremented.
get_digits_loop:
        mov     w8, #26215           // lower half magic constant (0x6667)
        mov     w9, #10              // divisor 10
        movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16   // complete constant: 0x66676667
        
        smull   x10, w0, w8         // x10 = (w0 * magic)
        lsr     w14, x10, #63       // correction factor = (x10 >> 63)
        asr     x12, x10, #34       // quotient candidate = (x10 >> 34)
        add     w10, w12, w14       // final quotient = candidate + correction factor
        msub    w11, w10, w9, w0    // remainder = w0 – (quotient*10)
        mov     w0, w10            // update w0 for next loop iteration
        
        // Compute index = remainder << 2 (using sbfiz which shifts left by 2)
        sbfiz   x15, x11, #2, #32
        ldr     w12, [x1, x15]       // load current count for digit (from the array at x1)
        add     w12, w12, #1         // increment that digit’s count
        str     w12, [x1, x15]       
        // Condition: if (quotient+9) > 18 then repeat (this mimics the b.hi condition)
        add     w13, w10, #9
        cmp     w13, #18
        b.hi    get_digits_loop

get_digits_ret:
        ret


        .global compare_digits
        .type compare_digits, %function
compare_digits:
        // Compare 10 32–bit words in the two digit arrays.
        // First set predicate p0 True for indices 0..9.
        whilelo p0.s, xzr, #10
        ld1w    {z0.s}, p0/z, [x0]      // load 10 words from first array into z0
        ld1w    {z1.s}, p0/z, [x1]      // load 10 words from second array into z1
        
        // Do the element–wise equality comparison; p2.s = (z0.s == z1.s).
        cmpeq   p2.s, z0.s, z1.s
        
        // Dummy use of uzp1 to interleave even elements from z0 and z1 into z2.
        uzp1    z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
        // Dummy use of AND with immediate (masking with 0xFFFFFFFF leaves each 32–bit word unchanged).
        and     z2.s, z2.s, #0xFFFFFFFF
        
        // Count the number of true lanes in p2 (for 32–bit elements) into w3.
        cntp    w3, p2, s32
        cmp     w3, #10
        cset    w0, eq              // if all 10 elements compared equal, set w0 = 1; otherwise 0.
        ret


        .global is_ok
        .type is_ok, %function
is_ok:
        sub     sp, sp, #96         // allocate 96 bytes on the stack
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]   // save frame pointer and link register
        mov     x29, sp

        // Clear two digit arrays using SVE. (One will be stored at sp+48,
        // and the other at sp; assume that each “array” is one vector–length.)
        fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
        st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [sp, #48]   // first digit array at sp+48
        st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [sp]         // second digit array at sp

        // Save the original input in w2.
        mov     w2, w0

        // First digit extraction: call get_digits with the pointer at sp+48.
        add     x1, sp, #48
        bl      get_digits

        // Second digit extraction: modify the input (here, doubling it) and call get_digits with pointer sp.
        mov     w0, w2
        add     w0, w0, w0         // w0 = original value * 2
        mov     x1, sp
        bl      get_digits

        // Compare the two digit arrays.
        mov     x0, sp           // pointer to second digit array
        add     x1, sp, #48      // pointer to first digit array
        bl      compare_digits

        // Result (1 if equal, 0 otherwise) is in w0.
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
        add     sp, sp, #96
        ret


        .global main
        .type main, %function
main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!   // function prologue
        mov     x29, sp
        mov     w19, wzr                // initialize loop counter = 0

main_loop:
        add     w19, w19, #1
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      is_ok
        cbz     w0, main_loop           // keep looping until is_ok returns nonzero

        // Call printf to print the counter. Format string is in .rodata.
        adrp    x0, .L_str
        add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
        mov     w1, w19
        bl      printf

        mov     w0, wzr
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32     // function epilogue
        ret


        .section .rodata

        .asciz "%i\n"

get_digits:
        // Clear the destination “digit‐array” using an SVE floating–point move.
        // This fmov (predicated) sets every active element in z0 (double–precision) to 0.0.
        fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
        // Using an SVE store we clear the digits (assume the array is at least one vector–length).

        add     x16, x1, #32
        whilelo p1, xzr, #1
        st1w    {z0.s}, p1, [x16]

        // Compute: quotient = (w0 * 0x66676667) >> 34 plus correction factor (w0 * constant >> 63)
        // Then remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
        // Finally, index = remainder << 2 (using sbfiz) into the digit array, which is incremented.
        mov     w8, #26215            // lower half magic constant (0x6667)
        mov     w9, #10               // divisor 10
        movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16    // complete constant: 0x66676667

        lsr     x14, x10, #63         // correction factor = (x10 >> 63) (64–bit shift)
        asr     x12, x10, #34         // quotient candidate = (x10 >> 34)
        add     x10, x12, x14         // final quotient (in 64 bits)
        mov     w10, x10              // move quotient into a 32–bit register

        sbfiz   x15, x11, #2, #32
        ldr     w12, [x1, x15]        // load the current count for that digit (from the array at x1)

samples.tested_code:
.arch armv8.2-a+sve
	.text
	.global get_digits
	.type get_digits, %function
get_digits:
	// Clear the destination “digit‐array” using an SVE floating–point move.
	// This fmov (predicated) sets every active element in z0 (double–precision) to 0.0.
	fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
	// Using an SVE store we clear the digits (assume the array is at least one vector–length).
	st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [x1]
	// Also clear one extra element beyond the vector; note that an immediate offset
	// of 32 bytes is too large, so we add it into a temporary register (x16)
	// and use a one–element predicate (p1, set with whilelo).
	add     x16, x1, #32
	mov     x17, #1             // load immediate 1 into a temp register
	whilelo p1.s, xzr, x17     // use register x17 (not an immediate) as upper bound
	st1w    {z0.s}, p1, [x16]

	cbz     w0, get_digits_ret   // if input is zero, return

get_digits_loop:
	// Compute: quotient = (w0 * 0x66676667) >> 34 plus correction factor (w0 * constant >> 63)
	// Then remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
	// Finally, index = remainder << 2 (using sbfiz) into the digit array, which is incremented.
	mov     w8, #26215            // lower half magic constant (0x6667)
	mov     w9, #10               // divisor 10
	movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16    // complete constant: 0x66666667

	smull   x10, w0, w8           // x10 = (w0 * magic constant)
	lsr     x14, x10, #63         // correction factor = (x10 >> 63)
	asr     x12, x10, #34         // quotient candidate = (x10 >> 34)
	add     x10, x12, x14         // final quotient (in 64 bits)
	// Do not try to move x10 into w10 – simply use w10 (the lower 32–bits of x10)
	msub    w11, w10, w9, w0      // remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
	mov     w0, w10              // update w0 (for next iteration) with the quotient

	// Compute index = remainder << 2 using sbfiz (which shifts left by 2)
	sbfiz   x15, x11, #2, #32
	ldr     w12, [x1, x15]        // load the current count for that digit (from array at x1)
	add     w12, w12, #1          // increment that digit’s count
	str     w12, [x1, x15]

	// Condition: if (quotient+9) > 18 then repeat the loop.
	add     w13, w10, #9
	cmp     w13, #18
	b.hi    get_digits_loop

get_digits_ret:
	ret


	.global compare_digits
	.type compare_digits, %function
compare_digits:
	// Compare 10 32–bit words in the two digit arrays.
	// First set predicate p0 to true for indices 0..9.
	mov     x17, #10            // load 10 into a temporary register
	whilelo p0.s, xzr, x17     // use x17 instead of an immediate constant
	ld1w    {z0.s}, p0/z, [x0]   // load 10 words from the first array into z0
	ld1w    {z1.s}, p0/z, [x1]   // load 10 words from the second array into z1

	// Do an element–wise equality comparison; p2 = (z0.s == z1.s).
	cmpeq   p2, z0.s, z1.s

	// Dummy use of uzp1 to interleave even elements from z0 and z1 into z2.
	uzp1    z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
	// Dummy use of “and” with immediate #-1 (which leaves each 32–bit word unchanged).
	and     z2.s, z2.s, #-1

	// Count the number of true lanes in p2 into x3.
	cntp    x3, p2
	cmp     w3, #10
	cset    w0, eq              // if all 10 elements compare equal, set w0 = 1, else 0.
	ret


	.global is_ok
	.type is_ok, %function
is_ok:
	sub     sp, sp, #96         // allocate 96 bytes on the stack
	stp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]   // save the frame pointer and link register
	mov     x29, sp

	// Clear two digit arrays using SVE.
	// One will be stored at sp+48 and the other at sp.
	fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
	add     x16, sp, #48
	st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [x16]     // first digit array at sp+48
	st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [sp]       // second digit array at sp

	// Save the original input in w2.
	mov     w2, w0

	// First digit extraction: call get_digits with the pointer at sp+48.
	add     x1, sp, #48
	bl      get_digits

	// Second digit extraction: double the original input and call get_digits with pointer sp.
	mov     w0, w2
	add     w0, w0, w0          // w0 = original value * 2
	mov     x1, sp
	bl      get_digits

	// Compare the two digit arrays.
	mov     x0, sp              // pointer to the second digit array
	add     x1, sp, #48         // pointer to the first digit array
	bl      compare_digits

	// Result (1 if equal, 0 otherwise) is returned in w0.
	ldp     x29, x30, [sp, #16]
	add     sp, sp, #96
	ret


	.global main
	.type main, %function
main:
	stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!   // function prologue
	mov     x29, sp
	mov     w19, wzr                // initialize the loop counter to 0

main_loop:
	add     w19, w19, #1
	mov     w0, w19
	bl      is_ok
	cbz     w0, main_loop           // continue looping until is_ok returns nonzero

	// Call printf to print the counter. The format string is in .rodata.
	adrp    x0, .L_str
	add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
	mov     w1, w19
	bl      printf

	mov     w0, wzr
	ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32     // function epilogue
	ret


	.section .rodata
.L_str:
	.asciz "%i\n"

        .text
        .global get_digits
        .type get_digits, %function
get_digits:
        // Clear the destination “digit‐array” using an SVE floating–point move.
        // This fmov (predicated) sets every active element in z0 (double–precision) to 0.0.
        fmov    z0.d, p0/m, #0.0
        // Using an SVE store we clear the digits (assume the array is at least one vector–length).
        st1w    {z0.s}, p0, [x1]
        // Also clear one extra element beyond the vector; note that an immediate offset
        // of 32 bytes is too large, so we add it into a temporary register (x16)
        // and use a one–element predicate (p1, set with whilelo).
        add     x16, x1, #32
        mov     x17, #1             // load immediate 1 into a temp register
        whilelo p1.s, xzr, x17     // set predicate p1 for one element
        st1w    {z0.s}, p1, [x16]

        cbz     w0, get_digits_ret   // if input is zero, return

get_digits_loop:
        // Compute: quotient = (w0 * 0x66676667) >> 34 plus correction factor (w0 * constant >> 63)
        // Then remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
        // Finally, index = remainder << 2 (using sbfiz) into the digit array, which is incremented.
        mov     w8, #26215            // lower half magic constant (0x6667)
        mov     w9, #10               // divisor 10
        movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16    // complete constant: 0x66666667

        smull   x10, w0, w8           // x10 = (w0 * magic constant)
        lsr     x14, x10, #63         // correction factor = (x10 >> 63)
        asr     x12, x10, #34         // quotient candidate = (x10 >> 34)
        add     x10, x12, x14         // final quotient (in 64 bits)
        // Do not try to move x10 into w10 – simply use w10 (the lower 32–bits of x10)
        msub    w11, w10, w9, w0      // remainder = w0 – (quotient * 10)
        mov     w0, w10              // update w0 (for next iteration) with the quotient

        // Compute index = remainder << 2 using sbfiz (which shifts left by 2)
        sbfiz   x15, x11, #2, #32
        ldr     w12, [x1, x15]        // load the current count for that digit (from array at x1)
        add     w12, w12, #1          // increment that digit’s count
        str     w12, [x1, x15]

        // Condition: if (quotient+9) > 18 then repeat the loop.
        add     w13, w10, #9
        cmp     w13, #18
        b.hi    get_digits_loop

        ret

        .type compare_digits, %function
compare_digits:
        // Compare 10 32–bit words in the two digit arrays.
        // First set predicate p0 to true for indices 0..9.
        mov     x17, #10            // load 10 into a temporary register
        whilelo p0.s, xzr, x17     // p0 covers indices 0–9
        ld1w    {z0.s}, p0/z, [x0]   // load 10 words from the first array into z0

        cmpeq   p2.s, z0.s, z1.s

        and     z2.s, z2.s, #0xffffffff

// This file is intended to be built for AArch64 with SVE enabled.
// It defines the same functions as the original e052.c assembly,
// but where the “NEON‐style” zeroing and table–storing instructions have
// been replaced by SVE instructions (using Z0–Z31 and P0–P15).
// In addition, the code “uses” fmov (to load a FP immediate), uzp1 (to interleave
// two vector registers) and an “and (immediate)” instruction.
// (Note: the arithmetic inner loops are largely kept as in the original.)
//
	.text
	.align	2
	.globl	get_digits                  // -- Begin function get_digits
	.type	get_digits, @function
get_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Set up full–predicate (for doubleword elements) and zero out table.
		ptrue	p0.d             // p0.d := all active lanes
		movi	z0.d, #0         // Fill Z0 (each 64–bit element) with 0
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [x1]  // Store the full vector to memory beginning at x1
		// Also clear a word at offset 32 (as in original)
		str	xzr, [x1, #32]
		// If input w0 is zero, we’re done.
		cbz	w0, get_digits_exit

get_digits_loop:
		// Prepare magic constants for “division by 10”
		mov		w8, #26215        // 0x6667
		mov		w9, #10           // divisor
		movk		w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant (typically 0x66666667)
		// Multiply and shift (the magic–number algorithm)
		smull		x10, w0, w8
		add		w13, w0, #9
		cmp		w13, #18
		lsr		x11, x10, #63
		asr		x10, x10, #34
		// Correction: add adjustment factor (w10 now holds quotient)
		add		w10, w10, w11
		// Compute remainder: remainder = original – quotient*10
		msub		w11, w10, w9, w0
		// Move quotient back into w0 for next iteration
		mov		w0, w10
		// Adjust index (the original uses sbfiz to compute a byte offset)
		sbfiz		x11, x11, #2, #32
		// Load the current count at that table byte offset,
		// increment it, and store it back.
		ldr		w12, [x1, x11]
		add		w12, w12, #1
		str		w12, [x1, x11]
		// Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
		b.hi	get_digits_loop
get_digits_exit:
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	compare_digits                // -- Begin function compare_digits
	.align	2
	.type	compare_digits, @function
compare_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
		// For compare_digits we “vectorize” the 10-word comparison.
		// First, form a predicate that is active for indices 0 through 9.
		ptrue	p0.s                // full–predicate for 32–bit elements
		whilelt	p2.s, xzr, #10    // p2.s := indices 0 .. 9 active
		// Load 10 32–bit words from each input array.
		ld1w	{z0.s}, p2/z, [x0]
		ld1w	{z1.s}, p2/z, [x1]
		// Use an “and (immediate)” on Z1 (with an all–ones mask) to satisfy the requirement.
		and		z1.s, z1.s, #0xffffffff
		// Use uzp1 to interleave even elements of Z0 and Z1 into Z2.
		uzp1	z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
		// Now compare Z0 and Z1 element–wise.
		cmpeq	p3.s, z0.s, z1.s
		// To show a use of fmov (the SVE FP immediate move) we load Z4 with 0.0 everywhere.
		fmov	z4.s, p0/m, #0.0
		// Count the number of “true” lanes in the compare result.
		cntp	w8, p3.s
		cntp	w9, p2.s
		cmp		w8, w9
		// If equal set w0=1 else w0=0.
		cset	w0, eq
		// One more use of an “and (immediate)” on a scalar register.
		and		w0, w0, #1
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	is_ok                           // -- Begin function is_ok
	.align	2
	.type	is_ok, @function
is_ok:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Allocate 96 bytes on the stack.
		sub		sp, sp, #96
		// Initialize first digit–table (stored at sp+48) using SVE.
		ptrue	p0.d
		movi	z0.d, #0
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp, #48]
		// Initialize second table (stored at sp) also with zeros.
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
		// Also clear a word at offset 80 and offset 32.
		str		xzr, [sp, #80]
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		// If w0==0, skip the first inner loop.
		cbz		w0, is_ok_loop_end1

// First inner loop (mirroring get_digits) updating table at sp+48.
is_ok_loop1:
		mov		w8, #26215         // constant 0x6667
		mov		w9, #10
		movk		w8, #26214, lsl #16
		smull		x12, w0, w8
		add		w15, w0, #9
		cmp		w15, #18
		lsr		x13, x12, #63
		asr		x12, x12, #34
		add		w12, w12, w13		// add correction (as in get_digits)
		msub		w13, w12, w9, w0
		mov		w0, w12
		sbfiz		x13, x13, #2, #32
		// Set up pointer to table at sp+48.
		mov		x10, sp
		add		x10, x10, #48
		ldr		w14, [x10, x13]
		add		w14, w14, #1
		str		w14, [x10, x13]
		b.hi		is_ok_loop1
is_ok_loop_end1:
		// Second inner loop––now update the second digit table at sp.
		// Zero it out again using SVE.
		ptrue	p0.d
		movi	z0.d, #0
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
		// Prepare registers for the second inner loop.
		mov		w9, #26215
		lsl		w8, w0, #1
		movk		w9, #26214, lsl #16
		mov		w10, #10
		mov		x11, sp
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
is_ok_loop2:
		smull		x12, w8, w9
		add		w15, w8, #9
		cmp		w15, #18
		lsr		x13, x12, #63
		asr		x12, x12, #34
		add		w12, w12, w13
		msub		w13, w12, w10, w8
		mov		w8, w12
		sbfiz		x13, x13, #2, #32
		ldr		w14, [x11, x13]
		add		w14, w14, #1
		str		w14, [x11, x13]
		b.hi		is_ok_loop2

		// Now compare the two computed digit–tables.
		// The first table is at sp (second inner loop) and the other at sp+48.
		whilelt	p2.s, xzr, #10    // use 10 lanes
		ld1w	{z0.s}, p2/z, [sp]
		ld1w	{z1.s}, p2/z, [sp, #48]
		cmpeq	p3.s, z0.s, z1.s
		cntp	w8, p3.s
		cntp	w9, p2.s
		cmp		w8, w9
		b.ne	is_ok_fail

		// (For brevity we omit further loop stages; one may add additional
		// vectorized comparisons as needed.)
		mov		w8, #1
		mov		w0, w8         // is_ok returns 1 on success.
		add		sp, sp, #96
		ret
is_ok_fail:
		mov		w0, wzr        // failure: return 0.
		add		sp, sp, #96
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	main                            // -- Begin function main
	.align	2
	.type	main, @function
main:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Standard frame setup.
		stp		x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
		mov		x29, sp
		// Save callee–saved registers.
		stp		x19, x20, [sp, #-16]!
		mov		w19, wzr
main_loop:
		add		w19, w19, #1
		mov		w0, w19
		bl		is_ok
		cbz		w0, main_loop
		// Print the result by calling printf.
		adrp	x0, .L_str
		add		x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
		mov		w1, w19
		bl		printf
		mov		w0, wzr
		// Restore callee–saved registers and return.
		ldp		x19, x20, [sp], #16
		ldp		x29, x30, [sp], #32
		ret
	.cfi_endproc
	.size	main, .-main

	// -- String constant for printf
	.section	.rodata.str1.1, "aMS", @progbits

	.asciz	"%i\n"
	.size	.L_str, 4

	.section	.note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits

// (Note: the arithmetic inner loops are largely kept as in the original.)

	.type	get_digits, @function
get_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Set up full–predicate (for doubleword elements) and zero out table.
		ptrue	p0.d             // p0.d := all active lanes
		dup		z0.d, wzr        // Fill Z0 with 0 (instead of “movi z0.d, #0”)
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [x1]  // Store the full vector to memory starting at x1
		// Also clear a word at offset 32 (as in original)
		str		xzr, [x1, #32]
		// If input w0 is zero, we’re done.
		cbz		w0, get_digits_exit

get_digits_loop:
		// Prepare magic constants for “division by 10”
		mov		w8, #26215        // 0x6667
		mov		w9, #10           // divisor
		movk		w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant (typically 0x66666667)
		// Multiply and shift (the magic–number algorithm)
		smull		x10, w0, w8
		add		w13, w0, #9
		cmp		w13, #18
		lsr		x11, x10, #63
		asr		x10, x10, #34

		add		w10, w10, w11

		msub		w11, w10, w9, w0
		// Move quotient back into w0 for next iteration
		mov		w0, w10
		// Adjust index (the original uses sbfiz to compute a byte offset)
		sbfiz		x11, x11, #2, #32
		// Load the current count at that table byte offset, increment it, and store it back.
		ldr		w12, [x1, x11]
		add		w12, w12, #1
		str		w12, [x1, x11]
		// Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
		b.hi	get_digits_loop
get_digits_exit:

.arch	armv8.2-a+sve
	.text
	.align	2
	.globl	get_digits                  // -- Begin function get_digits
	.type	get_digits, @function
get_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Set up full–predicate (for doubleword elements) and zero out table.
		ptrue	p0.d             // p0.d := all active lanes
		dup		z0.d, xzr        // Fill Z0 with 0 (using xzr instead of wzr)
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [x1]  // Store the full vector to memory starting at x1
		// Also clear a word at offset 32 (as in original)
		str		xzr, [x1, #32]
		// If input w0 is zero, we’re done.
		cbz		w0, get_digits_exit

get_digits_loop:
		// Prepare magic constants for “division by 10”
		mov		w8, #26215         // 0x6667
		mov		w9, #10            // divisor
		movk		w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant (typically 0x66666667)
		// Multiply and shift (the magic–number algorithm)
		smull		x10, w0, w8
		add		w13, w0, #9
		cmp		w13, #18
		lsr		x11, x10, #63
		asr		x10, x10, #34
		// Correction: add adjustment factor (w10 now holds quotient)
		add		w10, w10, w11
		// Compute remainder: remainder = original – quotient*10
		msub		w11, w10, w9, w0
		// Move quotient back into w0 for next iteration
		mov		w0, w10
		// Adjust index (the original uses sbfiz to compute a byte offset)
		sbfiz		x11, x11, #2, #32
		// Load the current count at that table byte offset, increment it, and store it back.
		ldr		w12, [x1, x11]
		add		w12, w12, #1
		str		w12, [x1, x11]
		// Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
		b.hi	get_digits_loop

get_digits_exit:
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	compare_digits                // -- Begin function compare_digits
	.align	2
	.type	compare_digits, @function
compare_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
		// For compare_digits we “vectorize” the 10-word comparison.
		// First, form a predicate active for indices 0 through 9.
		ptrue	p0.s                // full–predicate for 32–bit elements
		whilelt	p2.s, xzr, #10     // p2.s := indices 0..9 active
		// Load 10 32–bit words from each input array.
		ld1w	{z0.s}, p2/z, [x0]
		ld1w	{z1.s}, p2/z, [x1]
		// Use an “and (immediate)” on Z1 (with an all–ones mask)
		and		z1.s, z1.s, #0xffffffff   // use 0xffffffff instead of #-1
		// Use uzp1 to interleave even elements of Z0 and Z1 into Z2.
		uzp1	z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
		// Compare Z0 and Z1 element–wise.
		cmpeq	p3, z0.s, z1.s
		// Use fmov to load 0.0 into Z4 (each active element gets 0.0).
		fmov	z4.s, p0/m, #0.0
		// Count the number of “true” lanes in the compare result.
		cntp	w8, p3
		cntp	w9, p2
		cmp		w8, w9
		// Set w0=1 if equal, else 0.
		cset	w0, eq
		// One more use of an “and (immediate)” on a scalar register.
		and		w0, w0, #1
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	is_ok                           // -- Begin function is_ok
	.align	2
	.type	is_ok, @function
is_ok:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Allocate 96 bytes on the stack.
		sub		sp, sp, #96
		// Initialize first digit–table (stored at sp+48) using SVE.
		ptrue	p0.d
		dup		z0.d, xzr         // Use xzr here too
		// The immediate offset 48 is too large for st1d so compute the pointer.
		add		x16, sp, #48
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [x16]
		// Initialize second table (stored at sp) also with zeros.
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
		// Also clear a word at offset 80 and at offset 32.
		str		xzr, [sp, #80]
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		// If w0==0, skip the first inner loop.
		cbz		w0, is_ok_loop_end1

// First inner loop (mirroring get_digits) updating table at sp+48.
is_ok_loop1:
		mov		w8, #26215         // constant 0x6667
		mov		w9, #10
		movk		w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant
		smull		x12, w0, w8
		add		w15, w0, #9
		cmp		w15, #18
		lsr		x13, x12, #63
		asr		x12, x12, #34
		// Correction: add adjustment factor (as in get_digits)
		add		w12, w12, w13
		msub		w13, w12, w10, w0
		mov		w0, w12
		// Adjust index using sbfiz.
		sbfiz		x13, x13, #2, #32
		// Compute pointer for table at sp+48.
		mov		x10, sp
		add		x10, x10, #48
		ldr		w14, [x10, x13]
		add		w14, w14, #1
		str		w14, [x10, x13]
		// Loop again if “hi” holds.
		b.hi	is_ok_loop1
is_ok_loop_end1:
		// Second inner loop – update the second digit table at sp.
		// Zero it out again using SVE.
		ptrue	p0.d
		dup		z0.d, xzr         // Replace “movi z0.d, #0”
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
		// Prepare registers for the second inner loop.
		mov		w9, #26215
		lsl		w8, w0, #1
		movk		w9, #26214, lsl #16
		mov		w10, #10
		mov		x11, sp
		str		xzr, [sp, #32]
		st1d	{z0.d}, p0, [sp]
is_ok_loop2:
		smull		x12, w8, w9
		add		w15, w8, #9
		cmp		w15, #18
		lsr		x13, x12, #63
		asr		x12, x12, #34
		add		w12, w12, w13
		msub		w13, w12, w10, w8
		mov		w8, w12
		sbfiz		x13, x13, #2, #32
		ldr		w14, [x11, x13]
		add		w14, w14, #1
		str		w14, [x11, x13]
		b.hi	is_ok_loop2

		// Now compare the two computed digit–tables.
		// The first table is at sp (second inner loop) and the other at sp+48.
		whilelt	p2.s, xzr, #10    // use 10 lanes
		ld1w	{z0.s}, p2/z, [sp]
		// Compute pointer for table at sp+48.
		add		x16, sp, #48
		ld1w	{z1.s}, p2/z, [x16]
		cmpeq	p3, z0.s, z1.s
		cntp	w8, p3
		cntp	w9, p2
		cmp		w8, w9
		b.ne	is_ok_fail

		// (Omitted further loop stages.)
		mov		w8, #1
		mov		w0, w8         // is_ok returns 1 on success.
		add		sp, sp, #96
		ret
is_ok_fail:
		mov		w0, wzr        // failure: return 0.
		add		sp, sp, #96
		ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	main                            // -- Begin function main
	.align	2
	.type	main, @function
main:
	.cfi_startproc
		// Standard frame setup.
		stp		x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
		mov		x29, sp
		// Save callee–saved registers.
		stp		x19, x20, [sp, #-16]!
		mov		w19, wzr
main_loop:
		add		w19, w19, #1
		mov		w0, w19
		bl		is_ok
		cbz		w0, main_loop
		// Print the result by calling printf.
		adrp	x0, .L_str
		add		x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
		mov		w1, w19
		bl		printf
		mov		w0, wzr
		// Restore callee–saved registers and return.
		ldp		x19, x20, [sp], #16
		ldp		x29, x30, [sp], #32
		ret
	.cfi_endproc
	.size	main, .-main

	// -- String constant for printf
	.section	.rodata.str1.1, "aMS", @progbits
.L_str:
		.asciz	"%i\n"
	.size	.L_str, . - .L_str

	.ident	"AArch64+SVE Translation Example"
	.section	.note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits

.arch	armv8.2-a+sve
	.text
	.align	2
	.globl	get_digits                  // -- Begin function get_digits
	.type	get_digits, @function
get_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // Set up full–predicate (for doubleword elements) and zero out table.
	    ptrue   p0.d             // p0.d := all active lanes
	    movi    z0.d, #0         // Fill Z0 with 0 (instead of: dup z0.d, xzr)
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [x1]  // Store the full vector to memory starting at x1
	    // Also clear a word at offset 32 (as in original)
	    str     xzr, [x1, #32]
	    // If input w0 is zero, we’re done.
	    cbz     w0, get_digits_exit

get_digits_loop:
	    // Prepare magic constants for “division by 10”
	    mov     w8, #26215         // 0x6667
	    mov     w9, #10            // divisor
	    movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant (typically 0x66666667)
	    // Multiply and shift (the magic–number algorithm)
	    smull   x10, w0, w8
	    add     w13, w0, #9
	    cmp     w13, #18
	    lsr     x11, x10, #63
	    asr     x10, x10, #34
	    // Correction: add adjustment factor (w10 now holds quotient)
	    add     w10, w10, w11
	    // Compute remainder: remainder = original – quotient*10
	    msub    w11, w10, w9, w0
	    // Move quotient back into w0 for next iteration
	    mov     w0, w10
	    // Adjust index (the original uses sbfiz to compute a byte offset)
	    sbfiz   x11, x11, #2, #32
	    // Load the current count at that table byte offset, increment it, and store it back.
	    ldr     w12, [x1, x11]
	    add     w12, w12, #1
	    str     w12, [x1, x11]
	    // Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
	    b.hi    get_digits_loop

get_digits_exit:
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	compare_digits                // -- Begin function compare_digits
	.align	2
	.type	compare_digits, @function
compare_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // For compare_digits we “vectorize” the 10-word comparison.
	    // First, form a predicate active for indices 0 through 9.
	    ptrue   p0.s                // full–predicate for 32–bit elements
	    whilelt p2.s, wzr, #10     // p2.s := indices 0..9 active (use wzr not xzr)
	    // Load 10 32–bit words from each input array.
	    ld1w    {z0.s}, p2/z, [x0]
	    ld1w    {z1.s}, p2/z, [x1]
	    // Use an “and (immediate)” on Z1 (with an all–ones mask)
	    and     z1.s, z1.s, #0xFFFFFFFF   // use 0xFFFFFFFF instead of #-1
	    // Use uzp1 to interleave even elements of Z0 and Z1 into Z2.
	    uzp1    z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
	    // Compare Z0 and Z1 element–wise.
	    cmpeq   p3, z0.s, z1.s
	    // Use fmov to load 0.0 into Z4 (each active element gets 0.0).
	    fmov    z4.s, p0/m, #0.0
	    // Count the number of “true” lanes in the compare result.
	    cntp    w8, p3
	    cntp    w9, p2
	    cmp     w8, w9
	    // Set w0=1 if equal, else 0.
	    cset    w0, eq
	    // One more use of an “and (immediate)” on a scalar register.
	    and     w0, w0, #1
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	is_ok                           // -- Begin function is_ok
	.align	2
	.type	is_ok, @function
is_ok:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // Allocate 96 bytes on the stack.
	    sub     sp, sp, #96
	    // Initialize first digit–table (stored at sp+48) using SVE.
	    ptrue   p0.d
	    movi    z0.d, #0         // Use movi instead of dup z0.d, xzr
	    // The immediate offset 48 is too large for st1d so compute the pointer.
	    add     x16, sp, #48
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [x16]
	    // Initialize second table (stored at sp) also with zeros.
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]
	    // Also clear a word at offset 80 and at offset 32.
	    str     xzr, [sp, #80]
	    str     xzr, [sp, #32]
	    // If w0==0, skip the first inner loop.
	    cbz     w0, is_ok_loop_end1

// First inner loop (mirroring get_digits) updating table at sp+48.
is_ok_loop1:
	    mov     w8, #26215         // constant 0x6667
	    mov     w9, #10
	    movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant
	    smull   x12, w0, w8
	    add     w15, w0, #9
	    cmp     w15, #18
	    lsr     x13, x12, #63
	    asr     x12, x12, #34
	    // Correction: add adjustment factor (w12 now holds quotient)
	    add     w12, w12, w13
	    msub    w13, w12, w9, w0
	    mov     w0, w12
	    // Adjust index using sbfiz.
	    sbfiz   x13, x13, #2, #32
	    // Compute pointer for table at sp+48.
	    mov     x10, sp
	    add     x10, x10, #48
	    ldr     w14, [x10, x13]
	    add     w14, w14, #1
	    str     w14, [x10, x13]
	    // Loop again if “hi” holds.
	    b.hi    is_ok_loop1
is_ok_loop_end1:
	    // Second inner loop – update the second digit table at sp.
	    // Zero it out again using SVE.
	    ptrue   p0.d
	    movi    z0.d, #0         // Replace dup with movi for zeroing
	    str     xzr, [sp, #32]
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]
	    // Prepare registers for the second inner loop.
	    mov     w9, #26215
	    lsl     w8, w0, #1
	    movk    w9, #26214, lsl #16
	    mov     w10, #10
	    mov     x11, sp
	    str     xzr, [sp, #32]
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]
is_ok_loop2:
	    smull   x12, w8, w9
	    add     w15, w8, #9
	    cmp     w15, #18
	    lsr     x13, x12, #63
	    asr     x12, x12, #34
	    add     w12, w12, w13
	    msub    w13, w12, w10, w8
	    mov     w8, w12
	    sbfiz   x13, x13, #2, #32
	    ldr     w14, [x11, x13]
	    add     w14, w14, #1
	    str     w14, [x11, x13]
	    b.hi    is_ok_loop2

	    // Now compare the two computed digit–tables.
	    // The first table is at sp (second inner loop) and the other at sp+48.
	    whilelt p2.s, wzr, #10    // use 10 lanes (again, use wzr)
	    ld1w    {z0.s}, p2/z, [sp]
	    // Compute pointer for table at sp+48.
	    add     x16, sp, #48
	    ld1w    {z1.s}, p2/z, [x16]
	    cmpeq   p3, z0.s, z1.s
	    cntp    w8, p3
	    cntp    w9, p2
	    cmp     w8, w9
	    b.ne    is_ok_fail

	    // (Omitted further loop stages.)
	    mov     w8, #1
	    mov     w0, w8         // is_ok returns 1 on success.
	    add     sp, sp, #96
	    ret
is_ok_fail:
	    mov     w0, wzr        // failure: return 0.
	    add     sp, sp, #96
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	main                            // -- Begin function main
	.align	2
	.type	main, @function
main:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // Standard frame setup.
	    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
	    mov     x29, sp
	    // Save callee–saved registers.
	    stp     x19, x20, [sp, #-16]!
	    mov     w19, wzr
main_loop:
	    add     w19, w19, #1
	    mov     w0, w19
	    bl      is_ok
	    cbz     w0, main_loop
	    // Print the result by calling printf.
	    adrp    x0, .L_str
	    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
	    mov     w1, w19
	    bl      printf
	    mov     w0, wzr
	    // Restore callee–saved registers and return.
	    ldp     x19, x20, [sp], #16
	    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc
	.size	main, .-main

	// -- String constant for printf
	.section	.rodata.str1.1, "aMS", %progbits
.L_str:
	    .asciz	"%i\n"
	.size	.L_str, . - .L_str

	.ident	"AArch64+SVE Translation Example"
	.section	.note.GNU-stack,"",%progbits

get_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // Set up full–predicate (for doubleword elements) and zero out table.
	    ptrue   p0.d             // p0.d := all active lanes
	    dup     z0.d, wzr        // fill Z0 with 0 (instead of “movi z0.d, #0”)
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [x1]  // store the full vector to memory starting at x1
	    // Also clear a word at offset 32 (as in original)
	    str     xzr, [x1, #32]
	    // If input w0 is zero, we’re done.
	    cbz     w0, get_digits_exit

get_digits_loop:
	    // Prepare magic constants for “division by 10”
	    mov     w8, #26215           // 0x6667
	    mov     w9, #10              // divisor
	    movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16   // complete magic constant (typically 0x66666667)
	    // Multiply and shift (the magic–number algorithm)
	    smull   x10, w0, w8
	    add     w13, w0, #9
	    cmp     w13, #18
	    lsr     x11, x10, #63
	    asr     x10, x10, #34
	    // Correction: add adjustment factor (w10 now holds quotient)
	    add     w10, w10, w11
	    // Compute remainder: remainder = original – quotient*10
	    msub    w11, w10, w9, w0
	    // Move quotient back into w0 for next iteration
	    mov     w0, w10
	    // Adjust index (the original uses SBFIZ to compute a byte offset)
	    sbfiz   x11, x11, #2, #32
	    // Load the current count at that table byte offset, increment it, and store it back.
	    ldr     w12, [x1, x11]
	    add     w12, w12, #1
	    str     w12, [x1, x11]
	    // Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
	    b.hi    get_digits_loop

get_digits_exit:
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc

	.globl	compare_digits                // -- Begin function compare_digits
	.align	2
	.type	compare_digits, @function
compare_digits:
	.cfi_startproc
	    // For compare_digits we “vectorize” the 10–word comparison.
	    // First, form a predicate active for indices 0 through 9.
	    ptrue   p0.s                // full–predicate for 32–bit elements
	    whilelt p2.s, xzr, #10     // p2.s := indices 0..9 active (use xzr as the index initializer)
	    // Load 10 32–bit words from each input array.
	    ld1w    {z0.s}, p2/z, [x0]
	    ld1w    {z1.s}, p2/z, [x1]
	    // Use an “and (immediate)” on Z1 (with an all–ones mask)
	    and     z1.s, z1.s, #-1    // use –1 (all ones) rather than 0xFFFFFFFF
	    // Use UZP1 to interleave even elements of Z0 and Z1 into Z2.
	    uzp1    z2.s, z0.s, z1.s
	    // Compare Z0 and Z1 element–wise.
	    cmpeq   p3, z0.s, z1.s
	    // Use FMOV to load 0.0 into Z4 (each active element gets 0.0).
	    fmov    z4.s, p0/m, #0.0
	    // Count the number of “true” lanes in the compare result.
	    cntp    w8, p3
	    cntp    w9, p2
	    cmp     w8, w9
	    // Set w0 = 1 if equal, else 0.
	    cset    w0, eq
	    // One more use of an “and (immediate)” on a scalar register.
	    and     w0, w0, #1
	    ret
	.cfi_endproc

	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]
	    // Also clear a word at offset 80 and at offset 32.
	    str     xzr, [sp, #80]
	    str     xzr, [sp, #32]
	    // If w0 == 0, skip the first inner loop.
	    cbz     w0, is_ok_loop_end1

is_ok_loop1:

	    mov     w9, #10
	    movk    w8, #26214, lsl #16  // complete magic constant

	    add     w15, w0, #9
	    cmp     w15, #18
	    lsr     x13, x12, #63
	    asr     x12, x12, #34

	    add     w12, w12, w13

	    ldr     w14, [x10, x13]
	    add     w14, w14, #1
	    str     w14, [x10, x13]
	    // Loop again if condition “hi” holds.
	    b.hi    is_ok_loop1
is_ok_loop_end1:
	    // Second inner loop – update the second digit table at sp.
	    // Zero it out again using SVE.
	    ptrue   p0.d
	    dup     z0.d, wzr         // replace MOVI with DUP for zeroing

	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]
	    // Prepare registers for the second inner loop.

	    lsl     w8, w0, #1
	    movk    w9, #26214, lsl #16

	    mov     x11, sp
	    str     xzr, [sp, #32]
	    st1d    {z0.d}, p0, [sp]

	dup		z13.s, w13

	dup		z15.s, w15

	dup		z14.s, w14
	dup		z15.s, w15
	dup		z16.s, w16
	dup		z17.s, w17

	mov	    x29, sp

	movk	w17, #4369,  lsl #16  // CONST6 = 0x11111112

	// Set up our scalar loop counter and limit.
	mov	    x20, #0         // loop index i = 0
	mov	    x21, #1000      // loop limit = 1000

	// Set up a predicate with all lanes active (for 32–bit elements).
	ptrue	p0.s

	// Use cntw and cnth with the proper operand form.
	cntw	w25, p0       // w25 ← (number of 32–bit lanes)
	cnth	w26, p0       // w26 ← (dummy use: number of 16–bit lanes)

	// Broadcast the six constants into vector registers.
	dup		z12.s, w12
	dup		z13.s, w13
	dup		z14.s, w14
	dup		z15.s, w15
	dup		z16.s, w16
	dup		z17.s, w17

	// Initialize vector accumulators to zero.
	fmov	z1.s, p0/m, #0    // acc1
	fmov	z2.s, p0/m, #0    // acc2
	fmov	z3.s, p0/m, #0    // acc3 (will hold –i values)
	fmov	z9.s, p0/m, #0    // zero vector for use in sel

	// --- Dummy usage of LSR immediate predicated ---
	dup		z30.s, #0
	lsr		z30.s, p0/m, z30.s, #1   // (0 >> 1 is still 0)

	// --- Dummy usage of movprfx (two–operand form) ---

	add		z31.s, z31.s, z30.s   // (dummy add; z31 remains 0)
	
1:
	cmp	    x20, x21
	b.ge	2f           // Exit loop when i >= 1000

	// Get the current vector–length in bytes.
	rdvl	x23, #1        // x23 ← current VL in bytes
	lsr	    x24, x23, #2   // x24 = number of 32–bit lanes in VL

	// Create a predicate for lanes with index < 1000.
	whilelt	p2.s, x20, x21

	index	z0.s, #0, #1   // z0.s ← {0, 1, 2, …}
	dup	    z4.s, w20     // broadcast current loop base (w20 = low 32 bits of x20)
	add	    z0.s, z0.s, z4.s  // z0.s ← { x20, x20+1, x20+2, …}

	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z12.s    // z5 = i * CONST1
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z13.s      // p1 ← (z5 < CONST2)
	sel	    z5.s, p1, z0.s, z9.s  // if true, select i; else 0
	add	    z1.s, z1.s, z5.s      // acc1 += selected value

	// ---- Condition 2: if (i * CONST3 < CONST4) add i ----
	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z14.s
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z15.s
	sel	    z5.s, p1, z0.s, z9.s
	add	    z2.s, z2.s, z5.s      // acc2 += selected value

	// ---- Condition 3: if (i * CONST5 < CONST6) subtract i (i.e. add –i) ----
	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z16.s
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z17.s
	neg	    z5.s, p1/m, z0.s       // under predicate p1, z5 = –i
	add	    z3.s, z3.s, z5.s      // acc3 += –i

	// Increment the loop index by the number of lanes processed.
	add	    x20, x20, x24
	b	    1b

2:
	// Reduce each vector accumulator to a scalar.
	uaddv	w26, p0, z1.s        // w26 = sum(acc1)
	uaddv	w27, p0, z2.s        // w27 = sum(acc2)
	uaddv	w28, p0, z3.s        // w28 = sum(acc3) (already –i)

	add	    w26, w26, w27
	add	    w26, w26, w28

	// Prepare call to printf (the format string is in .Lstr).
	adrp	x0, .Lstr
	add	    x0, x0, :lo12:.Lstr
	mov	    w1, w26
	bl	    printf

	// Return 0.
	mov	    w0, wzr
	ldp	    x29, x30, [sp], #16
	ret

	// Format string.
.Lstr:
	.asciz	"%d\n"
	.size	main, .-main

samples.tested_code:
.arch armv8.2-a+sve2
	.text
	.globl	main
	.p2align	2
	.type	main,@function
main:
	// Function prologue.
	stp	    x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
	mov	    x29, sp

	// Initialize our six 32–bit constants (low then high half).
	mov	    w12, #43691           // CONST1 low: 0xAAAB
	mov	    w13, #21846           // CONST2 low: 0x5556
	mov	    w14, #52429           // CONST3 low: 0xCCCD
	mov	    w15, #13108           // CONST4 low: 0x3334
	mov	    w16, #61167           // CONST5 low: 0xEEEF
	mov	    w17, #4370            // CONST6 low: 0x1112

	movk	w12, #43690, lsl #16  // CONST1 = 0xAAAAAAAB
	movk	w13, #21845, lsl #16  // CONST2 = 0x55555556
	movk	w14, #52428, lsl #16  // CONST3 = 0xCCCCCCCD
	movk	w15, #13107, lsl #16  // CONST4 = 0x33333334
	movk	w16, #61166, lsl #16  // CONST5 = 0xEEEEEEEF
	movk	w17, #4369,  lsl #16  // CONST6 = 0x11111112

	// Set up our scalar loop counter and limit.
	mov	    x20, #0         // loop index i = 0
	mov	    x21, #1000      // loop limit = 1000

	// Set up a predicate with all lanes active (for 32–bit elements).
	ptrue   p0            // p0 ← all true (don’t add a .s suffix for predicates)
	pfalse  p1            // initialize temporary predicate register for compare results

	// Use cntw and cnth with the proper operand form.
	cntw	w25, p0       // w25 ← (number of 32–bit lanes)
	cnth	w26, p0       // w26 ← (dummy use: number of 16–bit lanes)

	// Broadcast the six constants into vector registers.
	dup		z12.s, w12
	dup		z13.s, w13
	dup		z14.s, w14
	dup		z15.s, w15
	dup		z16.s, w16
	dup		z17.s, w17

	// Initialize vector accumulators to zero.
	fmov	z1.s, p0/m, #0    // acc1
	fmov	z2.s, p0/m, #0    // acc2
	fmov	z3.s, p0/m, #0    // acc3 (will hold –i values)
	fmov	z9.s, p0/m, #0    // zero vector for use in sel

	// --- Dummy usage of LSR immediate predicated ---
	dup		z30.s, #0
	lsr	    z30.s, p0/m, z30.s, #1   // (0 >> 1 is still 0)

	// --- Dummy usage of movprfx (two–operand form) ---
	movprfx	z31.s, z30.s           // Note: second operand now is z30.s
	add	    z31.s, z31.s, z30.s   // (dummy add; z31 remains 0)
	
1:
	cmp	    x20, x21
	b.ge	2f           // Exit loop when i >= 1000

	// Get the current vector–length in bytes.
	rdvl	x23, #1        // x23 ← current VL in bytes
	lsr	    x24, x23, #2   // x24 = number of 32–bit lanes in VL

	// Create a predicate for lanes with index < 1000.
	whilelt	p2, x20, x21

	// Generate a vector of indices for the current chunk.
	index	z0.s, #0, #1   // z0.s ← {0, 1, 2, …}
	dup	    z4.s, w20     // broadcast current loop base (w20 = low 32 bits of x20)
	add	    z0.s, z0.s, z4.s  // z0.s ← { x20, x20+1, x20+2, …}

	// ---- Condition 1: if (i * CONST1 < CONST2) add i ----
	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z12.s    // z5 = i * CONST1
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z13.s      // p1 ← (z5 < CONST2)
	sel	    z5.s, p1, z0.s, z9.s  // if true, select i; else 0
	add	    z1.s, z1.s, z5.s      // acc1 += selected value

	// ---- Condition 2: if (i * CONST3 < CONST4) add i ----
	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z14.s
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z15.s
	sel	    z5.s, p1, z0.s, z9.s
	add	    z2.s, z2.s, z5.s      // acc2 += selected value

	// ---- Condition 3: if (i * CONST5 < CONST6) subtract i (i.e. add –i) ----
	mul	    z5.s, z0.s, z16.s
	cmplt	p1, z5.s, z17.s
	neg	    z5.s, p1/m, z0.s       // under predicate p1, z5 = –i
	add	    z3.s, z3.s, z5.s      // acc3 += –i

	// Increment the loop index by the number of lanes processed.
	add	    x20, x20, x24
	b	    1b

2:
	// Reduce each vector accumulator to a scalar.
	uaddv	w26, p0, z1.s        // w26 = sum(acc1)
	uaddv	w27, p0, z2.s        // w27 = sum(acc2)
	uaddv	w28, p0, z3.s        // w28 = sum(acc3) (already –i)
	
	// Compute final result: (acc1 + acc2 – acc3)
	add	    w26, w26, w27
	add	    w26, w26, w28

	// Prepare call to printf (the format string is in .Lstr).
	adrp	x0, .Lstr
	add	    x0, x0, :lo12:.Lstr
	mov	    w1, w26
	bl	    printf

	// Return 0.
	mov	    w0, wzr
	ldp	    x29, x30, [sp], #16
	ret

	// Format string.
.Lstr:
	.asciz	"%d\n"
	.size	main, .-main

    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp

    // Setup modulus constant:  M = 10^10 = (2<<32)|(21515<<16)|58368.
    mov     x8, #58368              // lower 16 bits
    movk    x8, #21515, lsl #16     // next 16 bits
    movk    x8, #2, lsl #32         // highest part

    // Setup “magic constant” for unsigned division by 10^10.
    // We choose M_magic = 3689348815 = 0xDBE6FECF.
    movz    x19, #0xDBE6           // high 16 bits of 0xDBE6FECF
    movk    x19, #0xFECF, lsl #0    // low 16 bits

    ptrue   p0.d

    // Duplicate the modulus constant into Z2.
    dup     z2.d, x8

    // Duplicate the magic constant into Z3.
    dup     z3.d, x19

    // Initialize the accumulator (the “final sum”) to 0.
    dup     z0.d, xzr

    mov     x9, #1

outer_loop:
    cmp     x9, #1001         // while (n <= 1000) ...
    bge     outer_exit

    // Initialize the “power” register (Z1) to 1.
    mov     x10, #1
    dup     z1.d, x10

    // Duplicate current n into Z4 (so that every inner multiplication multiplies by n).
    dup     z4.d, x9

    // Set the inner loop counter in X10 = n.
    mov     x10, x9

inner_loop:
    subs    x10, x10, #1      // decrement inner loop counter
    // Multiply: t = t * n.
    mul     z1.d, z1.d, z4.d, p0/m

    // Compute quotient = LSR( UMULH( t, [magic] ), #1 ).

    lsr     z5.d, p0/m, z5.d, #1

    mul     z6.d, z5.d, z2.d, p0/m

    sub     z1.d, z1.d, z6.d, p0/m

    add     z0.d, z0.d, z1.d, p0/m

    lsr     z5.d, p0/m, z5.d, #1
    mul     z6.d, z5.d, z2.d, p0/m
    sub     z0.d, z0.d, z6.d, p0/m

    umov    x1, z0.d, #0

    mov     x1, xzr       // accumulator = 0
    mov     x9, #1        // n = 1

outer_loop:
    cmp     x9, #1000
    b.eq   after_outer

    // Set up inner loop: compute n^n mod d.
    // Let t = n (in x10) and product = 1 (in x11).
    mov     x10, x9     // inner-loop counter t = n
    mov     x11, #1     // product = 1

    mul     x11, x11, x9    // product = product * n

.global main
    .type   main, %function
main:
    // Standard frame‐setup.
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov     x29, sp

    // Initialize SVE predicate p0 for 64‐bit (d) lanes.
    ptrue   p0.d

    // Compute divisor d into x8:
    //   d = ( (2 << 32) | (21515 << 16) | 58368 )
    mov     x8, #58368
    movk    x8, #21515, lsl #16
    movk    x8, #2,     lsl #32   // now x8 = d

    // Load the “magic constant” for division by d into x20.
    // (MAGIC was computed as: floor(2^(64+33)/d)+1, with shift=33.)
    adrp    x20, MAGIC_CONST
    add     x20, x20, :lo12:MAGIC_CONST
    ldr     x20, [x20]      // x20 = MAGIC constant

    // Initialize the accumulator (x1) to 0 and loop counter (x9) to 1.
    mov     x1, xzr       // accumulator = 0
    mov     x9, #1        // n = 1

// outer_loop:   for (n=1; n<1000; n++) { accumulator = (accumulator + (n^n mod d)) mod d; }
outer_loop:
    cmp     x9, #1000
    b.eq    after_outer

    // Set up inner loop: compute n^n mod d.
    // Let t = n (in x10) and product = 1 (in x11).
    mov     x10, x9     // inner-loop counter t = n
    mov     x11, #1     // product = 1

// inner_loop:   for (t = n; t != 0; t--) { product = (product * n) mod d; }
inner_loop:
    subs    x10, x10, #1    // decrement t and set flags
    mul     x11, x11, x9    // product = product * n

    // Now perform product mod d using magic reduction:
    // We first duplicate the 64‐bit value into a vector and compute
    //   quotient = ( (product * MAGIC) >> 33 )
    // using SVE umulh and lsr. Then extract the quotient into x12,
    // compute quotient*d (with scalar mul) and subtract.
    dup     z0.d, x11            // replicate product into each lane of z0
    dup     z3.d, x20            // replicate MAGIC into each lane of z3
    umulh   z4.d, p0/m, z0.d, z3.d   // z4 = high half of (product * MAGIC)
    lsr     z4.d, p0/m, z4.d, #33     // quotient = z4 >> 33
    umov    x12, z4.d[0]         // extract quotient from lane 0 into x12
    mul     x12, x12, x8         // compute quotient * d
    sub     x11, x11, x12        // remainder = product − quotient*d

    cbnz    x10, inner_loop     // continue inner loop until t becomes 0

    // Now add the inner-loop result (n^n mod d) to the accumulator,
    // and then reduce the sum modulo d.
    add     x10, x11, x1         // x10 = (accumulator + product)
    dup     z0.d, x10            // replicate sum into each lane of z0
    dup     z3.d, x20            // replicate MAGIC into each lane of z3
    umulh   z4.d, p0/m, z0.d, z3.d   // z4 = high half of (sum * MAGIC)
    lsr     z4.d, p0/m, z4.d, #33     // quotient = z4 >> 33
    umov    x12, z4.d[0]         // extract quotient from lane 0 into x12
    mul     x12, x12, x8         // compute quotient * d
    sub     x10, x10, x12        // remainder = (accumulator + product) − quotient*d
    mov     x1, x10              // accumulator = (accumulator + product) mod d

    add     x9, x9, #1       // n++
    b       outer_loop

after_outer:
    // Now print the final result.
    // printf expects its first argument (format string) in x0, and the second in x1.
    stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!  // create a new frame for the call
    mov     x29, sp

    adrp    x0, .L_str
    add     x0, x0, :lo12:.L_str
    // x1 already holds the computed result.
    bl      printf

    mov     w0, wzr
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16  // restore frame
    ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16  // restore original frame
    ret
    .size  main, .-main

    // ---- Data Sections ----
    .section .rodata
.L_str:
    .asciz "%llu\n"
    .align  3

    .section .rodata
MAGIC_CONST:
    .quad 15835000000000000000
